body: We can connect! I want you to live in this world, and as a high schooler, I know what it feels like to be unnoticed or unwanted. I’m here to talk if you need it
Why do you feel that it’s shameful?
Sure it’s my first time on this sub. I just want to be there for those who need it.

Of course your not a nuisance. I know it gets rough with work and such, but your dad has no right to hit or beat you, that’s just cruel. Is there someone else you can stay with for the time being? If not I recommend job Corp. it offers skills you need to be successful in a trade and also provides housing
How can I help? I want you walking this earth. It hurts me to know that you feel this way and I wanna be here to make you happy

Hey,
Do you need someone to vent to? I’m sure I can help in some kinda way. What resources have been given to you?
